items.title: Pi bond ki reactivity (print mein doosra 11.7.1) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Reactivity of the pi bond, printed as a second 11.7.1 on pages 257-258.

blocks.text: Double bond ki wajah se alkenes alkanes se zyada reactive hain. Pi bond mein electrons ke milne ka imkan do nuclei ko milane wali lakeer se door hai, to pi electrons nuclei ke darmiyan kam mazbooti se pakre hain; is liye pi bond sigma bond ke muqable kamzor hai aur reaction ke doran nisbatan aasani se toot-ta hai, alkenes ko compounds ka reactive group banate hue. Mazeed, dheele pakre pi electrons electrophilic reagents ke hamle ke liye zyada khule hain, to alkenes electrophilic addition reactions bohat aasani se karte hain.

blocks.title: Electrophile aur nucleophile
blocks.text: Electrophile woh species hai jo electron-pair qubool karne wale ka kaam kar sake, E+ se zahir. Nucleophile woh species hai jo electron ka jora dene wale ka kaam kar sake, Nu- se zahir. Alkenes nucleophiles ka kaam karte hain kyunke un mein pi electrons hain.

Paude ethene ko qudrati pakane wale hormone ke taur par banate hain; phal aur sabziyan aksar behtar katai aur transport ke liye kachi tor kar ethene ke samne rakhi jati hain taake woh thore waqt mein pak jayein.

blocks.prompt: H2, H+ aur OH- mein se kaun nucleophile aur kaun electrophile ka kaam karega, aur kyun (Quick Check 11.5b se e)?
blocks.explanation: OH- nucleophile hai: us par manfi charge aur lone pairs hain jo woh de sakta hai. H+ electrophile hai: us ke paas electrons nahi aur woh jora qubool karta hai. H2 na yeh na woh; yeh bhara hua sigma bond wala non-polar molecule hai jis ke paas dene ya lene ke liye na charge hai na lone pair.

items: Pi electrons nuclei ki lakeer se door, kamzori se pakre aur khule hain: pi bond aasani se toot-ta aur electrophiles ko kheenchta hai, to alkenes electrophilic addition karte hain.
Electrophile E+ = electron-pair qubool karne wala; nucleophile Nu- = electron-pair dene wala; alkene ke pi electrons use nucleophile banate hain. Ethene paudon ka pakane wala hormone hai.
